from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, List

class CashFlowEntry(BaseModel):
    """One cash flow data point extracted from a financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    reporting_year: Optional[int] = Field(description="The year of the report")
    period_type: Optional[str] = Field(description="Report period type, e.g., Q1, Q3, 1-9 months, 1-3 months")
    is_consolidated: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this is consolidated statement (True) or parent company only (False)")
    amount_yuan: Optional[float] = Field(description="Cash paid to employees and for employees in yuan")
    unit: Optional[str] = Field(description="Unit of the amount, e.g., 'yuan', 'thousand yuan'")
    comparative_amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="Amount from the comparative period mentioned in the report")
    comparative_year: Optional[int] = Field(description="Year of the comparative period")
    document_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Name or identifier of the source document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_entries: List[CashFlowEntry]
